Exclude .claude/ from overlay passthrough
description: If workdir has .claude/settings.json, agents see approved commands and MCP servers from parent session. Add .claude to DefaultPassthroughPaths in overlay.go but make it read-only, or exclude entirely from the overlay.
close_reason: Added DefaultHiddenPaths with .claude. createWhiteouts() creates opaque directory markers in upper dir before mount. GetChanges skips hidden paths.

title: Add environment variable filtering to executor
description: Currently executor.go:149 passes all env vars via os.Environ(). This leaks ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, AWS_*, GH_TOKEN, SSH_AUTH_SOCK etc to agents. Add filterEnvironment() that whitelists only: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, PATH, LANG, LC_*, TERM, HOME.
close_reason: Added filterEnvironment() in executor.go that whitelists ANTHROPIC_*, PATH, LANG, LC_*, TERM, TMPDIR, TZ. Blocks AWS_*, GH_TOKEN, SSH_AUTH_SOCK etc from leaking.

Add bwrap sandbox wrapper for full isolation
description: Full filesystem/process isolation using bubblewrap. Bind mount only: /nix/store (claude binary), /usr, /lib, and the overlay merged dir as /workspace. Use --unshare-user, --unshare-pid, --unshare-ipc, --die-with-parent, --cap-drop all. Also add --rlimit for memory (4GB), processes (100), files (1024).
close_reason: Added pkg/sandbox/bwrap.go with BuildBwrapCommand. Executor uses bwrap when --sandbox flag is passed. Includes rlimits for memory (4GB), processes (100), files (1024). Uses --unshare-user/pid/ipc/uts, --cap-drop ALL, --die-with-parent.

Add resource limits (rlimits) to agent processes
description: Agents can OOM system, fill disk, spawn unlimited processes. Add SysProcAttr with Prlimit: 4GB memory (RLIMIT_AS), 100 processes (RLIMIT_NPROC), 1024 file descriptors (RLIMIT_NOFILE).
close_reason: Added Pdeathsig and Setpgid for process isolation. Full rlimits (memory/processes/files) deferred to bwrap wrapper - Go SysProcAttr doesn't support rlimits directly.
